detailed_script:
# A Little Star Finds Home

Internal working name only; no title card. Runtime: exactly 120 seconds. Aspect: 21:9. Planned output: 720p.

A lovely wordless story in soft tactile 3D plush animation. No titles, subtitles, speech, lyrics, credits or narration. Humming and affectionate nonverbal sounds are allowed. Any later added dialogue must be Japanese.

## 00:00–00:12 (12s) — An unexpected twinkle

Five friends finish a peaceful evening game in a clover clearing. A small gold glimmer drifts down and settles safely into the shallow moss hollow. Mochi notices it, and everyone turns toward the sound.

Pacing: Establish all five identities and shared geography, then allow a readable discovery.

## 00:12–00:26 (14s) — A little star feels far from home

Mochi kneels beside the dim star and cups it softly. The star tilts one point toward the sky, where there is a small gap among distant points of light. Mochi cuddles it; Hina touches its side. Its first tiny pulse answers their care.

Pacing: Read the star’s wish without speech and establish that affection makes it brighten.

## 00:26–00:40 (14s) — A brave little try

On soft grass beside the hollow, Tora gently raises the star, makes one modest hop and releases it upward only a paw-height. It descends slowly like a feather; Mochi catches it safely. Tora looks bashful; Mochi nudges his shoulder reassuringly.

Pacing: Give the attempted solution a clear setup, gentle failure and affectionate reaction.

## 00:40–00:56 (16s) — A blue lift and a warm cuddle

Sora offers its rounded top as a cushion. The star settles on it, and Sora floats upward to roughly one friend-height. The star looks toward the much higher sky; Sora eases back down. Hina folds its small wings around the star, which brightens briefly with a soft chime.

Pacing: Let the blue friend help through its own physical gift, and repeat the glow clue through warmth.

## 00:56–01:08 (12s) — Mimi hears the answer

Mimi listens close to the star through its headphones. The star chimes a tiny three-note pattern. Mimi hums that wordless pattern gently. The star pulses brighter and floats a finger-width. Mimi’s ears perk; the friends notice the discovery.

Pacing: Give the listener a specific observation, response and visible cause-and-effect.

## 01:08–01:26 (18s) — Five small voices, one big kindness

At the lower slope, the five form a loose circle around the star. Mimi begins the same three-note hum; Mochi, Hina, Tora and Sora join one by one, each briefly seen. With each voice, one of the star’s five points brightens. The star begins hovering steadily between them.

Pacing: Allow every character a turn and make collective warmth the earned solution.

## 01:26–01:46 (20s) — Homeward on a lullaby

The friends take tiny steps up the short slope while continuing their gentle hum, with the floating star at chest level in front of them. At the crest they settle together. The fully lit star slowly rises, circles them once in gratitude, then lifts toward the open lavender sky. All five wave or raise their little arms.

Pacing: Preserve a calm emotional payoff with readable ascent, gratitude and collective goodbye.

## 01:46–02:00 (14s) — A thank-you above the meadow

The star takes its place among the distant lights and sends the same three-note chime. Below, the five nestle shoulder to shoulder on the crest. Tora leans into Mochi, Hina rests close, Sora floats just above the grass, and Mimi smiles. One final gold twinkle lights their cheeks. Hold on their quiet happiness; end on the image with no text or credits.

Pacing: Resolve the homecoming, confirm the friendship and leave a gentle final hold.

SCENE CONTEXT
Five friends finish a peaceful evening game in a clover clearing. A small gold glimmer drifts down and settles safely into the shallow moss hollow. Mochi notices it, and everyone turns toward the sound. The point is a gentle act of shared care, readable through physical action and expressive posture.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
Exactly 12 seconds, 21:9, 720p native output. Premium stylized 3D PLUSH ANIMATION, tactile microfiber characters, handcrafted miniature felt environment, rounded original cartoon proportions. Fluid small real-time movement, gentle expressive squash-and-stretch. No live-action people. Wordless. No titles, subtitles, captions, text, logos, watermarks or credits.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
@Mochi: One cheerful WHITE plush friend. Preserve the rounded white silhouette, small pink-interior ears, curved black happy eyes, oval black nose, pink-tongue smile and round blush cheeks. Compact short limbs. This sheet gives body and face views of ONE assembled living plush, not three objects or detached anatomy. Personality through gentle head tilts and caring paw movements.
@Hina: One BUTTER-YELLOW plush friend. Preserve two round head nubs, black highlighted oval eyes, orange triangular embroidered beak, round pink cheeks, yellow wing-arms and orange feet. One assembled living plush. Never replace the round nubs with a comb or pointed ears.
@Tora: One APRICOT-ORANGE plush tiger. Preserve THREE black forehead markings, half-lidded highlighted eyes, white double-lobed muzzle, paired cheek marks, short striped arms, leg patch and tiny black belly dot. Rounded scalloped cheeks. One assembled living plush. Brave but sweet; express bashfulness by body posture without redesigning the embroidery.
@Sora: One POWDER-BLUE plush teardrop friend, a single continuous round-topped body tapering to a lower tip, two small side flippers, black dot eyes, curved stitched smile and round blush cheeks. One assembled living plush. No legs, ears, nose, keychain loop or hardware. Its lower point gently hovers two centimeters above the grass unless this timeline explicitly gives a higher float.
@Mimi: One CREAM-WHITE plush headphone cat. Preserve gray triangular ears with pink centers, tiny black face features, flower-shaped pink cheeks and gray headphones with dusty-pink ear cushions. The headphones stay on. One assembled living plush. The ear embroidery and flower-shaped cheeks must remain legible.
@Star: Exactly ONE small creamy-gold felt baby star with FIVE rounded points, two black dot eyes, curved stitched mouth and subtle blush. Canonical prop shape/material from the reference, with emission state controlled by the timeline. One third of a friend’s head width. No limbs. It floats gently by fairytale physics; never transforms, splits or grows. Its three-note chime is C5–E5–G5.
@Meadow: Environment geometry and tactile materials only: felt clover clearing, shallow moss hollow near screen-left foreground, low grassy slope and rounded crest screen-right, distant rounded trees left, open lavender sky. Use the same meadow at the progressively later evening time specified here. Do not reproduce the empty plate as a still frame or copy its 16:9 crop; compose this action in 21:9.
Character sheets control identity, facial embroidery and assembled anatomy ONLY. Never render their studio backgrounds, panel arrangement, detached body/head views or additional copies. No keychains, rings, hanging loops, fabric product labels or writing. The two original photographs already grounded these selected sheets and are not scene compositions.

LOCATION MAP / FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
Wide eye-level 21:9 composition. @Mochi stands screen-left nearest the hollow. @Hina is just right of @Mochi, @Tora center, @Sora center-right hovering low, @Mimi far right. All five face each other in a loose friendly arc, full faces and bodies assembled. The sky occupies the upper third. @Star is initially a very small distant gold point high above the hollow. Camera is a third-person plush-eye-level view; left sunset key and right slope maintain the established geography.

FORMAT MODE / ACTION TIMING
Three consecutive timed shots with the explicitly described hard cuts. No extra montage, flashback, added scene or unplanned transition.
Shot 1 (0-4s): CAMERA / OPTICS: Wide, 35mm equivalent, fixed plush-eye-level camera; enough depth of field for all five. VISUALS & ACTION: The five finish a playful gentle sway in their loose arc, tiny limbs moving naturally; @Mochi notices a distant golden glimmer above screen-left and lifts its face. The others follow the same eyeline without changing places. AUDIO: Soft grass footsteps, faint breeze, a quiet celesta and pizzicato phrase. No voices. END STATE: All five look up toward the arriving point.
Shot 2 (4-8s): CAMERA / OPTICS: Hard cut to a low medium-wide 50mm view of the hollow; small downward tilt follows only the last part of descent. VISUALS & ACTION: @Star drifts slowly down diagonally from upper-left to the moss hollow, its five-point form becoming visible. It settles softly into the hollow with one gentle bounce and remains dim. No impact, crater, dust burst or distress. AUDIO: One delicate descending bell shimmer, soft felt landing. END STATE: One dim star lies safely in the moss hollow.
Shot 3 (8-12s): CAMERA / OPTICS: Hard cut to medium 65mm; @Mochi and the hollow sharp, the four friends softly readable behind. VISUALS & ACTION: @Mochi takes two small steps and kneels beside the hollow, lowering its face toward @Star with a caring tilt. The other four watch in the background in their established order. Hold the affectionate discovery for the last second. AUDIO: Felt footsteps and a tiny breathy nonverbal wonder sound without syllables. END STATE: @Mochi kneels beside the dim star; the others remain close.

PHYSICS
Soft stuffed bodies have contact, weight and slightly compressible plush surfaces. Short feet plant on grass; only the blue teardrop naturally hovers low. Supporting paws touch the star before a transfer releases it. The star obeys the exact gentle fairytale floating described above, never teleporting. No snapping, limb growth, anatomical fusing, bouncing camera or uncontrolled throws. All short limbs remain plush paws/flippers, no human fingers. Preserve one star and its five points.

LIGHTING
Late peach sunset, soft warm key from offscreen left, lavender ambient sky. Keep exposure steady and highlights soft. Soft tactile fiber highlights, pastel saturation, gentle contrast; preserve white, yellow, orange and blue character colors. Star bloom remains controlled so face embroidery is legible. No flashes, flare, strobe or neon.

AUDIO
Native synchronized sound. The complete layers are: soft evening breeze and tiny grass/felt Foley; only the timed chimes and nonverbal reactions listed; gentle celesta and soft pizzicato in a quiet C-major bedtime theme; closed-mouth wordless C5–E5–G5 humming ONLY where specified. Instrumental score stays low enough to hear the story clue. No human-language words, narration, spoken dialogue or sung lyrics in any language. If any vocal utterance beyond nonverbal humming occurs, Japanese is the only allowed spoken language; prefer none. No harsh sounds or dramatic action score.

POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS / CONTINUITY LOCKS
Exactly 5 named friends exist in this scene, each ONCE, plus ONE baby-star prop. Only the subjects named in this chapter appear. Every friend is one complete living plush with connected head/body, the canonical facial embroidery, colors and short limbs. No duplicate identities or reference-sheet triplets. Warm cooperative tone throughout, no distress or injury. Keep the same meadow geography, current evening light and precise prop ownership. Maintain all shot intervals exactly and a usable final hold. Full-width 21:9 image with no artificial black bars. No text of any kind, title cards, subtitles or end credits.
